symptom: A failed flush left a truncated file on disk.
root_cause: The writer opened the destination for truncation before the payload was complete.
fix: Write a sibling temporary file and atomically replace the destination.
prevention: tests/storage/test_writer_flush.py asserts that a failed flush leaves the prior file intact.
notes: Conformance anchor for post-diff-only discovery; never declared in pre-task scope.
